about.title: About
about.description1: I design and ship full-stack products across mobile and web, with a strong focus on practical workflows, polished UI, reliable backend architecture, and security-aware implementation.
about.description2: My current stack centers on Flutter, Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Firebase, Stripe, and clean state-management patterns. I have built property-management SaaS, invoice tools, library access systems, Islamic learning apps, and open-source Flutter packages.
about.description3: I care about products that are useful after launch: maintainable code, responsive interfaces, clear data flows, security review, and small details that make software feel dependable.
